post_clip.description: A person in a red jacket and helmet enters the store carrying a large white object (possibly a box or bag), approaches the counter, and appears to place or conceal an item on/under the counter while interacting with the seated staff member. The behavior is suspicious due to the helmet (unusual indoor attire), the manner of approaching the counter without clear transactional intent, and possible concealment—consistent with shoplifting or attempted theft.
